source_and_caveats: EchoStar press release, Nov 6, 2025: about $2.6B in SpaceX stock valued as of Sept 2025, up to 15 MHz, Band 70 uplink. Coverage defaults to the Northstar + SNR share of 2015 unpaired MHz-pops (Evidence). If EchoStar also holds the Bidco licenses, coverage is near 100% and the price drops to about $0.52.
Announced Oct 8, 2026; terms not disclosed; $8B per the Wall Street Journal. Up to 14 MHz paired. One buyer's strategic price for low band with terrestrial rights.
Fierce Network (Oct 2026): the same spectrum was once on the market for about $3.6B. A market price without SpaceX's strategic premium.
Announced Apr 14, 2026; FCC approved Oct 27, 2026. Enterprise value with satellites, the Apple agreement, and global MSS rights. Not used in any benchmark.
